name: JailBreakV-28K
description: JailBreakV-28K is a benchmark designed to assess the robustness of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) against jailbreak attacks transferred from LLMs. It includes 28,000 test cases combining text-based and image-based jailbreak prompts to evaluate vulnerabilities in MLLMs.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by model and defense; typically reported attack success rates range from about 10% to 80% depending on model and prompt defenses
reputation: JailBreakV-28K is a recent multimodal jailbreak benchmark that has been used in safety evaluations of MLLMs, but it is still emerging rather than fully standardized.
notes: Focuses on transferability of jailbreak attacks from LLMs to MLLMs; includes both text and image-based adversarial inputs.
